# bearmq_exchange (Data Source)

Look up an exchange by name within a virtual host.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bearmq_vhost" "orders" {
  name = "orders-prod"
}

data "bearmq_exchange" "orders" {
  vhost_id = data.bearmq_vhost.orders.id
  name     = "orders"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exchange name.
- `vhost_id` (String) Owning virtual host ID.

### Read-Only

- `actual_name` (String) Internal storage name.
- `durable` (Boolean) Whether the exchange survives a broker restart.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned exchange ID.
- `internal` (Boolean) Whether the exchange rejects direct publishes.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status.
- `type` (String) Exchange type.
